capabilities: Render a Bases query as a matrix of files and list properties
Drag and drop items between cells, rows, columns, and the unassigned pool
Save dragged items back to the underlying list properties automatically
Reserve an unassigned pool for items not yet placed
disambiguation: Not a task planner on its own; it only redistributes items of Bases list properties across queried files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A custom Obsidian Bases View for visually distributing list property items using Drag & Drop.
problem: Obsidian has no visual way to move list items between properties on multiple files; edits must be made file by file.
summary: Bases view that distributes list-property items across files and an unassigned pool via drag and drop.
